behavior: Fragment texture/program input DMA0/1 and vertex input DMA0/1 are copied into immutable draw command bytes before queueing. Rebinding these inputs no longer downloads pending attachments. Attachment DMA changes and synchronization methods retain their barriers.

tests.realWebGPU: Both fragment program DMA selectors independently fetch distinct 0.25 and 0.5 constant programs from rebased DMA mappings; additive draws retain one batch and one color readback, producing RGBA 191. Full GPU regression passed.

limitation: No native FPS or driver timeout claim is made from this batching regression.
